tldr: A randomized trial and an independent covariate-only registry have a fixed-parameter comparability elbow. With \(N\) observations at each site and \(N\) cells, exact comparability \(C=1\) forces equal covariate laws: a deterministic zero-request reply of \(\lceil\log_2(N+1)\rceil\) bits attains minimax MSE of order \(N^{-1}\). Every legal protocol satisfies \(R_1^{\rm TF}(N,B)\ge\max\{1/(1024N),(8\pi e)^{-1}4^{-B}\}\), so the necessary and sufficient communication scale for this accuracy is \(\Theta(\log N)\). For every fixed \(C>1\), unknown positive comparable masses allow arbitrarily rare cells and give minimax MSE of order \(\log^{-2}(eN)\), attained by two fully charged finite messages at every fixed positive polynomial pilot exponent. The inherited polynomial, occupancy correction, coordinate sampling, finite encoding, and published one-arm lower input support this incremental synthesis. A rational connected interval has finite 90 percent coverage in the fixed-interior construction. The fixed-\(C>1\) minimum sufficient bit budget remains open.
gap: Occupancy-polynomial OPE results assume supplied target weights and minimum behavior-mass information. Regular transportation efficiency theory does not give a finite-bit worst-case guarantee over this unrestricted sparse-cell experiment.
fill: A total target-first encoder pays for each target label and one scalar reply, retains the centralized logarithmic accuracy order uniformly over positive comparable masses, and supplies an explicit conservative honest interval. The statistical lower comparison uses only the verified overlap-one-quarter control-zero input.
